Added 8/29/2025 by Ryan Cahill
The implementation previous to this time had native ResSim DS control rules for both Harrisburg and Jasper (same ones as LOP).
But this was causing very weird behavior at Lookout Point, where the Jasper rule was preventing it from evacuating well after the event.
This behavior was solved by removing the rules at Hills Creek and just keeping Jasper at LOP as a native DS control rule.
In reality, Hills Creek also operates for Jasper, but this is handled indirectly by the Harrisburg rule and any balancing ops with LOP.
